title: A Quantum Search Approach to Magic Square Constraint Problems with Classical Benchmarking
summary: This paper presents a quantum search approach to combinatorial constraint satisfaction problems, demonstrated through the generation of magic squares. We reformulate magic square construction as a quantum search problem in which a reversible, constraint-sensitive oracle marks valid configurations for amplitude amplification via Grover's algorithm. Classical pre-processing using the Siamese construction and partial constraint checks generates a compact candidate domain before quantum encoding.
